title: Credits of a theme's image files
description: Lists every file in the theme's assets/ folder with its author, source and licence. Only CC0-1.0 and MIT (art made for this repository) are allowed; any other licence is a decision for the product owner.

file.description: Path relative to the theme's folder.

author.description: A public author or project; never a family member's name.

licence.description: An SPDX identifier from the allowed list (checked by validate-theme).
